theorems.name: Submission.lpf_pi_induced_orientation
theorems.statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Eucl P), ‖simpleNVector v‖ ^ 2 = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)).det) ∧ ∀ (P n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), simpleNVector (fun i => ∑ j, B i j • τ j) = B.det • simpleNVector τ) → ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P) (A : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q) (w : NVector (Eucl P) n), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (w = simpleNVector τ ∨ w = -simpleNVector τ) → nVectorPushforward n A w ≠ 0 → LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i => A (τ i)) ∧ ∃ σ : Fin n → Eucl Q, Orthonormal ℝ σ ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (range σ) = Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun i => A (τ i))) ∧ (nVectorPushforward n A w = ‖nVectorPushforward n A w‖ • simpleNVector σ ∨ nVectorPushforward n A w = -(‖nVectorPushforward n A w‖ • simpleNVector σ))
